notes:
⟦{湯呑|ゆの}→湯呑：noentry⟧み (full form: ⟦{湯呑|ゆの}→湯呑：noentry⟧み⟦{茶碗|ぢゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧) is a cylindrical cup without a handle, used primarily for drinking Japanese green tea. Unlike Western teacups, ⟦{湯呑|ゆの}→湯呑：noentry⟧み are held with both hands.

Characteristics:
- Typically ceramic or porcelain
- Cylindrical shape with no handle
- Often larger for men (⟦{大|おお}→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ぶり) and smaller for women (⟦{小|こ}→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ぶり)
- Many households have personalized ones for each family member

Related:
- ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧ (rice bowl; also used for matcha)
